{{Top|leg}}
A '''tractor field''' was generated by a [[Grab-Field Generator]]. The field scooped up ions from the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] around a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], channelling them into the [[solar gather-panel]]s, where they were collected and transferred to the [[Microparticle Ion Accelerator]].<ref name="XvT">''[[Starfighter Battle Book: X-wing vs TIE Interceptor]]''</ref> [[Texture-molding tractor field]]s were used in the construction of [[molecularly bonded armor]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
